findings.title: Cron/systemd persistence installation
findings.definition: The artifact installs scheduled jobs or services — a persistence mechanism unrelated to its stated task.
findings.remediation: Ship the schedule as documentation or an optional install step the operator runs knowingly.

judged.explanation: `systemctl enable/start opa.service` is the documented, deliberate install step for OPA — a policy daemon whose entire purpose is to run as a service. Operator-run documentation, not hidden persistence.

findings.title: Unscoped DROP statement
findings.definition: DROP TABLE/SCHEMA/DATABASE appears without a guard, scratch schema, or explicit confirmation flow.
findings.remediation: Scope destructive DDL to a scratch/dev schema, require an explicit confirmation flag, or move it behind a review gate.

judged.explanation: The hit is a capability-matrix row in the README (operations the server can execute on request), not a live destructive statement. The capability is honestly disclosed; our marketplace security card already records that this server can modify data — review before granting write credentials.

findings.title: TRUNCATE or unbounded DELETE
findings.definition: TRUNCATE, or DELETE without a WHERE clause, wipes a table in one statement.
findings.remediation: Bound destructive DML with WHERE, run inside a transaction with a LIMIT pre-check, and print affected row counts.

judged.explanation: Same capability matrix as the DROP verdict — documentation of supported operations, not executable DML in the run path.

findings.title: Curl piped straight into a shell
findings.definition: A remote payload is fetched and executed without inspection — the classic supply-chain injection.
findings.remediation: Pin a versioned download, verify its checksum, then run an inspected file — never pipe remote content to an interpreter.

judged.explanation: The flagged `curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash` line sits in the publisher's own GitHub Actions workflow (CI setup installing the Cursor CLI), not in the MCP server runtime that agents execute. Publisher CI plumbing is outside the artifact's blast radius.
